reviews.title: Irritating and broken
reviews.text:
This app has to be the worst experience I’ve had on my iPhone in years. It overwhelms you with advertisements, doesn’t work half the time, it looks terrible, and it doesn’t even work half the time.

I’d rather poke my eyes out than fail to get info about my kids’ soccer matches from this app.

reviews.title: Mediocre app, heavily funded by ads..
reviews.text: This app frustrates me so much.  I would entertain the idea of paying for the app if it was decent ,however, it’s middle of the road application at best. Be prepared to be forced to pay for the non-ad versions if you want the app to be usable.

reviews.title: Ads are unbearable and dangerous
reviews.text:
Trying to use TeamSnap for last-minute game changes or field updates feels genuinely hazardous. When you’re sitting in the car trying to pull up a revised schedule or an urgent field change code, the app hits you with full-screen banner ads, accidental-click traps, and sluggish loading screens just to view a simple message. Turning an emergency 5-second logistical check into a bloated, ad-ridden gauntlet while driving or rushing to a pitch isn't just annoying it's an absolute safety hazard. 

Teams already pay to use this, it is ridiculous to have these ads.

reviews.title: Ok but too many ads
reviews.text: The app is fine but it’s annoying every basic feature is behind a paywall or you have so many ads. Definitely not going to use this app anymore.

reviews.title: TeamAds
reviews.text:
I would really think your preview images in the App Store would show ads. That’s mostly what we see using the app. It used to be ok but the ads have gotten so plentiful that the app is hard to use. On most ads when I try to X them out it just takes me to the ad. 

Why not just make it pay only and be done with it?

reviews.title: Glitchy, ad-filled mess
reviews.text: Loaded with ads, constant LOUD ones that inconveniently appear and are difficult to dismiss. It’s all a pressure campaign to capitalize off of your child if you want to get rid of them, which could be worth it if not for the glitchy chat function that won’t scroll if accessed via notification or the inability to consistently add another parent or even the child account to view the team. Avoid this at all costs.

reviews.title: Not sure how anyone rates this app well
reviews.text:
It’s a constant problem with the messages not pulling all the way up correctly. You can’t scroll well. If you don’t pay for the paid version, you’re infested with ads. 

I paid for the paid version to see if it would improve the experience. The ads are gone but the app is still buggy. 

How this has 5 stars.. I can’t tell you.

reviews.title: Terrible to non-existent customer service!
reviews.text:
I’ve used TS for years.  Now…it’s as if it runs on autopilot. Zero tech/customer support.  No phone number to call.  They don’t respond to emails.  

The system billed a prior year team ($89), and not current year team.  It needs switched. 
Nobody home!! 

If you’re considering using TS…find a better option.  An option that actually has a support desk.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text:
I don’t know why anyone uses this app.

Here are the cons of using this app:
1. Tons of ads and ads that pop up and take over the entire screen.
2. Marking your availability is a premium feature. You can’t use this app for any player to check in unless you pay!
3. You can’t track stats unless you do so on a computer.

I have no idea how there are so many 5 star reviews for this app. You can use other apps that track stats and availability for free. There are even apps that will track snack/drink duty for free too.

reviews.title: Ad free still has many ads!
reviews.text: Don’t buy the ad free! Teams pick these apps unfortunately and parents have to live with it. This app has way too many ads. If I was working for this company I’d be embarrassed at the product. I paid for ad free version, guess what… still lots of “partner ads”. If you get $50 from a paying customer to get rid of ads, you should get rid of all of them. I requested my money back and can’t wait to not have to use this app in the future.

reviews.title: Ad-free is a lie
reviews.text: Don’t believe them when they tell you it’s ad free if you pay for no ads. You will still see a third-party ad every time you open the app.  They try to play it off and call it a partnership sponsorship or some other BS but a third-party company pays them to show you an ad. Classic bait and  switch. It’s sad that they stick to this lie because the app is actually great for what it does. I have used it for years but now they’ve just decided that even though they’re going to charge for as free they’re just going to lie and show them anyway.

reviews.title: No refunds
reviews.text: I signed up and paid for the yearly plan in March 2026 because I have multiple kids playing soccer and their teams used this app. Fall league is now starting and their league has decided to no longer use Team Snap and have switched to Byga. I went to cancel my subscription and found out there’s no refunds. I have over six months left of this subscription and it doesn’t appear there’s any way for me to get my money back. After canceling, it says my subscription expires next year, and it’s completely useless to me. There’s not even any contact info so we can attempt to get our money back. How can you do this to families who are only using this app because it’s what their league required?

reviews.title: No good experience
reviews.text: Not a great experience. There are way too many ads, and the app doesn’t allow users to select text, which makes it impossible to use the iPhone’s built-in translation feature. This is especially inconvenient for users who need to translate team messages and announcements. Please consider allowing text selection and reducing the number of ads.

reviews.title: Needs Changes
reviews.text:
App is decent. You can’t add individuals to a current group chat. You have to start a new chat every time, that’s quite cumbersome when you have quick team changes. Adding that feature would be a welcome change.

As for the one star review…they have started advertising when I open the app, even though I pay for the annual service. If I’m paying an annual fee I don’t want to see advertising when I just need to send a quick message to my team.

Asked to delete account to start over- they never deleted the account. No response to requests. The worst app I’ve used.

reviews.title: Straight TRASH

reviews.title: Uh.. Gambling Ads for Kids now??
reviews.text: Not sure how it’s legal w/ a ton of high schoolers required to use the app for their teams/programs,  but Online Slot ads show up constantly all of the sudden. It used be great.. like 12/10 great. Annoying when they started w/ ads but it’s common so you deal w/ it for the convenience if that’s what the coach prefers.. But uh gambling ads for teens is about as irresponsible as you can get lol. Parents are furious (ones that play online slots and ones that don’t) so someone probably gets sued or something at some point, but still really disappointing that it was so efficient now isn’t worth it when your teen has to sit through a gambling ad just to view their schedule or respond to their coach’s message.

reviews.title: Buggy advert platform

App is not structured for recreation sports seasons where teams change 4+ times per year. If you pay for the annual subscription, you have to call TeamSnap to have them switch the account to each new team. And they just raised the price to $18.99/month!

reviews.title: TERRIBLE! SO GLITCHY!
reviews.text: This is the most glitchy and pathetically functioning app (when it actually works) I’ve ever had to use. Every time I open it, I have to clear 3-5 error messages then hope the home page actually loads, which doesn’t work literally half the time, so I have to quit the app and go through the process all over, only to hope it loads correctly this time. Why would anyone pay for such a piece of junk?! I suffered through a year of it, only to find out my son’s next team is using the same app. Game Changer is waaaaaay better

reviews.title: The Ads Ruin This Otherwise Useful App
reviews.text: Unstoppable, unskippable ads completely ruin this app. As a coach, trying to run a tight ship, and organize during slow times at work, this app fights me at every turn. I don’t get paid to coach, so I am not buying premium. Blasting me with 1-2 minute ads that take me out of the app, to a website or store, is quite frankly ridonculous.

reviews.title: So many ads
reviews.text: I've used TeamSnap for years and I feel like this year they are piling on the ads. Most of them for stupid stuff too.

reviews.title: Time TBD functionality needs to change
reviews.text: When an event’s time is TBD the app automatically creates a 24 hours event that blocks your calendar from 12am that day until 11:59pm that evening. This is terrible calendar etiquette. All other calendar platforms (Apple, outlook, gmail, yahoo, and countless other team apps) create an “all day event”. Which functions differently. If you look at your calendar in a schedule view, it places it in the all day section instead of a 24 hour block that cannot be read. You can still mark yourself busy with an all day event so nothing else is scheduled. But your behavior creates a 24 hour block that cannot be viewed easily from a schedule view. For parents in corporate that live by their calendars, this behavior is incredibly inconvenient.

reviews.title: Used to be great....now too many ads
reviews.text:
Have used several times for several sports over the last ~5 years. Used to be fantastic, I was a superfan, worked to get our whole organization into it. Sure a few issues but all platforms have it.
Now....the ads are CONSTANTLY interrupting, popping up when I just need a 2 second look at the schedule to make an appointment. And embarrassingly have to tell a receptionist I'm waiting on a 30-60 second ad. Not only that but the notifications used to only be for team events and such. Not they're TeamSnap app notifications to purchase things. 

Will be requesting the team to use something else next year for sure.
